findings.summary: Minus signs on fund differences and the comparison box look like losses; it is unclear what they are compared against.
The word 'מדד' isn't explained; an older reader may take it to mean the price index.
The first option buttons are in English, so the page feels foreign.
Small grey text on a dark background can't be read even when enlarged.
Sliders plus pre-filled amount boxes make it unclear whether to type your own amount.
No mention of risk and no comparison with a bank deposit.
A floating round arrow button covers the text at the ends of lines.
The cost strips use similar orange, yellow and red colours that can't be told apart.
Too many numbers in a row in the bank list is tiring and makes the reader anxious.
It is unclear who 'מקור' is and why they should be trusted.
